title: First benchmarked training experiment: end-to-end run, checkpoint samples, and benchmark results
body:
Turns the repo from benchmark-capable to benchmark-demonstrated: runs a real training experiment, scores checkpoint samples against the canonical eval set, and commits all artifacts alongside a findings doc.

## Bug fix: canonical prompt loader

`_load_canonical_prompts` used `Path(__file__).parents[5]` to locate `configs/canonical_prompts.json`, which resolves to the org directory (one level above the repo root), not the repo root. Fixed to `parents[4]`. Without this, sample generation silently fell back to two stub prompts that don't appear in the eval set — making all benchmark prompt-match counts wrong regardless of model quality.

```python
# Before — resolved to /org-dir/configs/ (doesn't exist)
repo_candidate = Path(__file__).parents[5] / "configs" / "canonical_prompts.json"
# After — resolves to repo root /configs/
repo_candidate = Path(__file__).parents[4] / "configs" / "canonical_prompts.json"
```

## First experiment artifacts (committed)

- **Model:** t-dev-6l, 6.6M params, 6 layers, hidden=256, float32, CPU
- **Data:** 20-sentence synthetic corpus, SentencePiece BPE vocab=512
- **Training:** 20 steps, AdamW lr=3e-4 — val loss 5.94 (step 10) → 6.01 (step 20)
- **Benchmark:** `smtx-mini-code-reasoning-v1`, 4 tasks, all prompts matched (`missing_task_count=0`), scores 0.00 (expected at this scale)
- Artifacts committed under `artifacts/runs/t_dev_6l_first_run/`: `training_summary.json/md`, per-checkpoint `samples/*.json`, consolidated `samples.json/md`, `config_used.json`, `benchmark_results.json/md`
- Large binaries (`.pt` checkpoints, tokenizer `.model`) excluded via new `.gitignore` rules

## Chained CI workflow

`.github/workflows/first-experiment.yml` — single `workflow_dispatch` job: data prep → tokenizer training → model training → benchmark scoring → uploads `first-experiment-run-artifacts` and `first-experiment-benchmark-outputs` as Actions artifacts.

## Findings doc

`docs/first-experiment-findings.md` covers: what was verified, what produced expected-zero scores and why, coverage gaps (corpus scale, step count, GPU path, benchmark breadth), and prioritised next steps.
